tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Porcelain white in light, graphite night in dark. Most of every screen is this colour.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, inputs and menus that sit on surface. Separate it with a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: switch tracks, empty meter segments, table header rows.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Cool silver as a material: large blocks, inactive pixels, illustration planes. Never text.

tokens.name: silver-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fills behind neutral labels and selected table rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel edges at stroke-hairline. Decorative only; it does not need 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that carry meaning (inputs, secondary buttons, switch tracks): 3:1 or more on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and teal-soft. 12:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, units and mono labels on any surface or teal-soft. 5.3:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: The deep neutral material: instrument panels, the cover slab, stat tiles inside dark cards. Carries on-graphite text, mint and signal pixels.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a graphite fill. 11:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action, active state, focus ring, links and the filled part of meters. As text, on surface, surface-raised and teal-soft (4.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind teal or ink text: selected nav item, teal Label.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill (the primary button). Dark text in the dark theme because teal lightens there.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Hero status cards (System status, Settings intro): the app's signature surface. Flat, never a gradient. Carries on-teal-deep text, mint and signal pixels.

tokens.name: teal-deep-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of a teal-deep card; lifts it off the graphite ground in dark.

tokens.name: teal-deep-raised
tokens.usage: Stat tiles and icon wells inside a teal-deep card; on-teal-deep text on it.

tokens.name: on-teal-deep
tokens.usage: Titles, values and icons on teal-deep (7.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-teal-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Mono eyebrows and secondary lines on teal-deep (5:1 or more).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Ice-mint accent, used small: a single lit pixel, the leading meter segment, the live dot inside a Label. Only on graphite, teal, teal-deep or under on-mint text. Never text on surface (1.2:1).

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text on a mint fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Amber lamp pixels, after a parametric tail-lamp: an unlocked car, a pending lock, a confirmation waiting. Lit pixels only, on graphite or teal-deep; never text, never a glow.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. An alias of teal, so it follows the accent in every theme.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, underlined at 1px with 3px offset.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution states (low range, cable unlocked). Always with a word. Text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Faults and destructive or risky actions (Unlock now). Always with a word or icon. Text on surface and surface-raised; as a fill, with on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (Unlock now).

tokens.name: tonal
tokens.usage: A fill, not text: tonal buttons (Reload vehicles) and stat tiles. Their labels are ink, which reads 11.5:1 on tonal in light and 9.2:1 in dark. In dark it is lifted to #343c41 so a tonal button separates from surface-raised.

tokens.name: mark-hi
tokens.usage: The lit facet of the LEAVE/LOCK mark: gunmetal on Porcelain, satin silver on Graphite. Mark only.

tokens.name: mark-lo
tokens.usage: The shaded facet, signal arcs and dissolving pixels of the mark. Mark only.

tokens.name: mark-rune
tokens.usage: The Bluetooth rune cut into the mark's body. Mark only.

families.body: "Instrument Sans Variable Font wdth,wght", "Instrument Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBMPlex Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Exo 2, a geometric techno sans with squared curves. Bold 700 for the LEAVE/LOCK wordmark only; SemiBold 600 for display headlines and the status word; Light 300 for readouts; Medium 500 for app headings. Sentence case. On Android bundle the variable font in res/font or load it as a downloadable Google Font.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The LEAVE/LOCK wordmark only: Exo 2 Bold, uppercase. Stacked as LEAVE over /LOCK, or on one line. Not for headings.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Web only: one hero line per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Web section openers; tablet screen titles.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Instrument numbers: charge, range, radius. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: The one-word state in a hero card (Watching, Locked, Paused).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Android top app bar title and web page titles.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card titles and settings group titles.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Row titles inside cards when they need more weight than body-strong.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans for everything people read. Keep lines near 66 characters.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: LEAVE/LOCK locks your car when you walk away.
styles.usage: Web lead paragraphs; hero card descriptions.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Primary trigger when you leave the car.
styles.usage: Default UI text; settings row descriptions.

groups.name: Utility
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono, used sparingly for labels and data. Labels are set uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, field labels, tags. Uppercase, ink-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Coordinates, codes, timestamps, units in tables.

spacing.note: A 4px base on an 8px rhythm. Prefer the larger step when unsure.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; one pixel unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of labels and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding; minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero padding on marketing pages.

tokens.name: pixel
tokens.usage: Side of one square pixel in the motif.

tokens.name: pixel-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between motif pixels.

radius.note: Rectangular with crisp corners. Cards are chamfered (see shape), not rounded. Nothing goes above radius-sm.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Pixels, meter segments, tables, page sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Labels, stat tiles, switch thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, switch tracks, menus, dialogs. The ceiling.

shadow.note: Almost never. Hairlines separate; a shadow only lifts something that floats.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and toasts. Never on panels or cards.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, panel edges, table rules (in line).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Active tab underline, focus ring width.

layout.note: Web: 12 columns with fixed gutters. Android: a single column with 16dp margins; 1px here = 1dp, type px = sp.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns on desktop; 4 on phones.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and between panels in a row.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable size on Android (48dp) and touch web.

tokens.name: screen-margin
tokens.usage: Android screen side margin and gap between stacked cards.

shape.note: The faceted-panel idea: one 45° cut on the top-right corner of every card, like a body crease. Sizes are cut lengths.

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Stat tiles and icon wells.

tokens.name: chamfer-md
tokens.usage: Cards and settings groups on Android.

tokens.name: chamfer-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards and web feature panels.
